Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorOperatingPointResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorOperatingPointResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CompressorOperatingPointResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, capacity-aware snapshot of one compressor operating point.

The result combines thermodynamic performance, compressor-map position, anti-surge recycle screening, pressure-target status, and the universal NeqSim capacity constraints. It is intended for production optimization, bottleneck analysis, field-life studies, and exchange with external energy and emissions tools.

All physical values use fixed units stated in the getter names and JavaDoc. Values that cannot be evaluated are represented by Double.NaN. The result does not retain references to the compressor or its mutable constraints.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim
